name: Solar Guardians USA
old_description: If the roof of your home is equipped with solar panels and the roof needs to be repaired, Solar Guardians USA can help. Our team specializes in solar panel removal and reinstallation for clients across New Jersey and Southeastern Pennsylvania. Find out more about what these services entail.
about:
Solar Guardians USA was founded in 2021 in Blackwood, New Jersey. The company operates as a solar repair and maintenance service provider for residential customers across New Jersey and southeastern Pennsylvania.

The company specializes in the service side of solar energy systems, offering panel removal and reinstallation for roof repairs, routine operation and maintenance, inverter repair and replacement, animal protection through critter guard installation, and consultation services including shading analysis and contract assessment. It does not install new systems but focuses on troubleshooting and restoring existing installations. The team works with a variety of racking components, inverters, and panel brands, and maintains two maintenance programs—one for newer installations and an extended program for systems over five years old.

Solar Guardians USA serves homeowners, solar financiers, leasing companies, and installation firms. It acts as a certified service provider for most large financiers and is an approved service contractor for brands such as SunPower and Sunova. The company also partners with multiple roofing contractors to coordinate roof repairs alongside solar system removal and reinstallation.

The business was built on the premise that solar system owners need dedicated service technicians rather than installers who prioritize new sales. It emphasizes its BBB accreditation, state electrical and home improvement licenses in New Jersey and Pennsylvania, and over 15 years of combined industry experience among its staff to differentiate itself in the market.
